_doc: Narration for presentation_v1.0. cues = the sentence as it appears in captions and in the SRT. tts = what is actually sent to edge-tts when the reading needs help (homophones for polyphonic characters, digits spelled out); it must have the same number of entries as cues. Pronunciation notes are in docs/demo/footage_log.md. 重 meaning 'again' is read zhong4 by this voice, so the word is avoided in narration rather than patched.

今天就帶大家開箱，我們做的這套系統。
打開網站，首頁只做一件事：貼上你收到的訊息。
可以貼文字，也可以貼網址，一次最多兩萬字。
下面有範例可以直接點，還有機器人的說明。
